title: Use the repository Node major before installing or testing
failureExamples: Node 24.x is required, but v26.6.0 is active. Switch Node versions before verifying or pushing.

guidance.when: A local version manager or agent shell is using a different Node major.
guidance.solution: Activate the major in .node-version, then rerun the failed phase.
guidance.tradeoffs: Changing package constraints hides environment drift, so prefer aligning the runtime unless the project intentionally upgrades Node.
